input.quote: 5. PERSONNEL. Each party agrees to assign one (1) existing sales or marketing employee primarily dedicated to assist in the sales and marketing promotional activity set forth in this Exhibit D.
input.rationale: No non-solicitation, no-hire or anti-poaching covenant exists anywhere in this Agreement, so the preferred position ("No non-solicit on Customer") is already met and no redline or counterparty comment is warranted. Verification performed: full-text searches for "solicit", "hire", "employ", "induce", "recruit", "entice" and "directly or indirectly" return no restrictive personnel covenant; Section 13 (Shared Resources), which seconds Commerce One operations, consulting and engineering personnel to work alongside Corio staff, ends at fees, Developments ownership, employee NDA/invention-assignment warranties and a covenant not to sue (p0114, p0116); Section 14 (Miscellaneous) was read in full and contains only assignment, waiver, governing law, notices, independent-contractor status (p0126), severability, force majeure, subcontracting, bankruptcy and integration terms; the only clause captioped "Personnel" (Exhibit D §5, p0203) merely requires each party to assign a sales/marketing contact. The integration clause (p0133) confirms the Agreement, Exhibits, NDA and Statement of Work are the complete and exclusive agreement, so no non-solicit is imported by reference. The failed deterministic checks on duration (≤12 months) and a general-solicitation carve-out are inapplicable: those parameters constrain the fallback position and there is no non-solicit clause here to constrain. Nothing binds Corio (our client, the licensee/customer) from soliciting or employing Commerce One personnel. Retained as internal evidence only; if Commerce One later proposes a personnel covenant, we would hold to the fallback (mutual, limited to personnel directly involved in the services, 12 months from the end of their involvement, general-advertising and unsolicited-approach carve-outs, no no-hire).
